title: Townsend Amphitheater

services.name: Private Rentals
services.desc: The UC Botanical Garden offers two spectacular venues for your special event. Host your ceremony surrounded by the beauty and grandeur of coast redwoods in our Mather Redwood Grove and Amphitheater. Celebrate with your guests in the historic Julia Morgan Hall, an incomparable setting nestled in the Garden. We invite you to explore our two rental facilities to host your next event. Perfect for weddings, celebrations, and work retreats. Drop in anytime during the Open House hours to visit the venues, pick up a cup of coffee and speak with our rental staff! services.name: Adult Tours
services.desc: Adult, docent-led tours are a wonderful way to experience the Garden in a deeper way with a volunteer docent guide. Our Adult and Senior Plants of the World Tour allows visitors to explore the Garden’s incredible diversity of plants from six continents, including environments as diverse as deserts, redwood forests, and wetlands. Plants are arranged naturalistically in the Garden according to region of origin-Asia, Australasia, California, Eastern North America, Mediterranean, Mexico/Central America, Deserts of the Americas, South America, and Southern Africa-allowing visitors to travel the world of plants. services.name: Green Stuff Summer Camp
services.desc: Introduce your child to the wonders of nature at our Green Stuff Summer Camp-an active hands-on science day camp for children entering grades 1 through 4, with a special “Alumni Week” for returning campers entering grades 5 and 6. Green Stuff is designed to be a small-group experience, with two counselors supervising 10 to 12 children per week. The counselors are a team of one lead staffer with a degree and experience in childhood education paired with a well-trained UC Berkeley undergraduate or graduate student in plant sciences, both of whom have experience and a love of sharing the wonders of the natural world with young children.
